page_title: ACM 1-0 BOL | AC Milan v Bologna 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Massimiliano Allegri, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90' The AC Milan players are stunned as referee Matteo Marcenaro changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
87' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for AC Milan as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
86' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.

86' A player from Bologna commits a rough challenge. Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to AC Milan.
85' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Santiago Tomas Gimenez is replaced by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan).

83' OFF THE POST! Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
83' The game has come to an end for Santiago Castro. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
82' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
81' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is penalised for a foul. Matteo Marcenaro had a clear view and blows his whistle.
81' A quickly taken corner by Bologna.
78' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
77' Luka Modric swings in the free kick towards Koni De Winter (AC Milan), who powers a header high over the bar from close in.
74' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Nicolo Cambiaghi and he is replaced by Jonathan Rowe (Bologna).
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Riccardo Orsolini as he is replaced by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
73' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Juan Miranda (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
73' The ratio of the ball possession is 38:62.
70' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Lukasz Skorupski.
68' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
67' Luka Modric (AC Milan) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
65' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuele Ricci replacing Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan).
65' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek did his best and is replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
63' Here's the change. Giovanni Fabbian leaves the pitch and Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
62' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Charalampos Lykogiannis will be replaced by Juan Miranda (Bologna).
61' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexis Saelemaekers plays a pass to the feet of Luka Modric (AC Milan), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:0.
59' A clever short pass gives Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
58' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
55' Mike Maignan has picked up an injury and is replaced by Pietro Terracciano (AC Milan).
53' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) picks up an injury.
53' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
52' The resulting free kick from Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
51' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marcenaro stops the game and makes a call. Free kick. Bologna will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
50' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukasz Skorupski, who smothers the ball.
47' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' Massimiliano Allegri has made a change at the break. Koni De Winter has come on in place of Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Luka Modric (AC Milan) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
40' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Luka Modric (AC Milan) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
36' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle. Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) commits a foul after dangerous play.
32' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
31' Santiago Castro (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.

28' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. AC Milan are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
24' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) misses a golden opportunity after his strike hits the post!
23' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
23' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
21' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' Mike Maignan pulls off a great save to deny Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net.
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
15' Luka Modric (AC Milan) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lukasz Skorupski reads it well and gathers the ball.
14' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
14' A cross by Remo Freuler (Bologna) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
12' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Luka Modric (AC Milan) took the corner.

11' A sweet pass finds Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Lukasz Skorupski is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. AC Milan win a corner.
10' Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.

10' Luka Modric (AC Milan) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
9' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul. It's a free kick to AC Milan in a dangerous position.
8' The corner from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is intercepted by Lukasz Skorupski.

8' Luka Modric (AC Milan) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' The corner from Luka Modric (AC Milan) is hurriedly cleared.
7' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
4' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) commits a foul and Matteo Marcenaro immediately signals a free kick.
2' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) commits a foul during an attacking move.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Matteo Marcenaro is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
